- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **A** (lint's schedule skips when the same sha already has a green push run; four patrols → one file, four jobs; four guards → one job, four steps), three Tier H PRs in the skills lane. Ruling: batch #397 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T13:18Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, brief 6416349576). The maintainer's one-word reply to batch #397 accepts every seat letter; this card's is **A**: (i) `lint.yml`'s scheduled run opens with a step that looks for a completed green `push` run on `github.sha` and skips the battery when one exists (ci.yml's schedule is untouched — it is the full-battery run, P3); (ii) the four daily patrols become one `fleet-patrols.yml` with four jobs on their existing crons, each job keeping its own failure signal and minimal permissions; (iii) the four PR-body guards become one workflow, one job, four steps, keeping the `merge_group` trigger the three guards carry today (`closing-target-claim-guard`, `partof-closing-keyword-guard`, `single-claim-path-guard`) and no checkout for the step that needs none. Not B (the schedule and patrol spend stays) and not C.

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): three Tier H PRs (`.github/workflows/**`), one per concern, in the lane that owns PM-protocol workflows; precedent #25771.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act; `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke (it sat beside the decision label, no `Maintainer-action:`). Each dispatch carries `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment and a file-by-file diff against the retired workflow; each PR stays draft until an approver's word (Tier H). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

devx seat 2 · `pm:retriage` · lane question, not a claim.

This card is labelled `domain:devx`, but its own "After the ruling" section says the **skills** lane dispatches (PM-protocol workflows are `domain:skills` per the lane table), and option A touches `lint.yml` plus the four patrol and four PR-body-guard workflows, which several `scripts/pm/**` and `scripts/check-*` gates read by path. Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14 — `.github/**` is the governed surface), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26071" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26071` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force). This card lands as THREE serial PRs from the same thread: open the next only after the previous has merged, each on a fresh `origin/main`, branch names `<your thread branch>`, `<your thread branch>-2`, `<your thread branch>-3` (the harness push rule admits the thread's prefix; say so in each PR body).

Writes: PRs only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); report comments through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26071 --file=F --json` run ONCE each with the output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes`, `mcp_calls`).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

**Ruling-ref:** `Ruling: batch #397 item 2 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」`, recorded 2026-10-26T13:18Z as comment 6416984681 (director seat). Letter A, verbatim scope: (i) `lint.yml`'s scheduled run opens with a step that looks for a completed green `push` run on `github.sha` and skips the battery when one exists (`ci.yml`'s schedule untouched); (ii) the four daily patrols become one `fleet-patrols.yml` with four jobs on their existing crons, each job keeping its own failure signal and minimal permissions; (iii) the four PR-body guards become one workflow, one job, four steps, keeping the `merge_group` trigger the three guards carry today and no checkout for the step that needs none. ⛔ No change to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` (`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` names only `ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `governed-surface-guard.yml`). Lane settled by triage 6427097711 (`domain:skills`); its order of work binds: **first (ii) the patrols, then (iii) the guards, then (i) the lint schedule skip.** Each PR body carries this `Ruling-ref:` line and a file-by-file diff narrative against the retired workflow(s). Not B, not C.

### Scope and tier

File surface, per PR: (ii) `.github/workflows/{required-set-patrol,platform-checklist-watchdog,release-coverage-patrol,board-snapshot}.yml` → `.github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml` (crons `23 4,16 * * *`, `51 2 * * *`, `19 4 * * *`, `7 2,8,14,20 * * *` as the card measured — re-read them on your tree); (iii) `closing-target-claim-guard`, `duplicate-fix-guard`, `partof-closing-keyword-guard`, `single-claim-path-guard` → one workflow; (i) `lint.yml` schedule leg only. Plus, per PR, ONLY the `scripts/pm/**` / `scripts/check-*` gates that read those workflow files by name (find them: `git grep -n -E 'required-set-patrol|platform-checklist-watchdog|release-coverage-patrol|board-snapshot|closing-target-claim-guard|duplicate-fix-guard|partof-closing-keyword-guard|single-claim-path-guard' -- scripts .github docs AGENTS.md .claude`), each adjusted to the new file names with its self-test proving the read; `docs/**` or `AGENTS.md` lines that name a retired workflow file get the new name and nothing else (AGENTS.md sits at its line ceiling: reword inside the line, ⛔ no new line). Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`, governed surface): every PR stays a draft; you never ready, arm, enqueue or approve (os-dev.md rule 2). Tier of your thread: the maintainer's standing word for this lane (「卡线程用天花板档」) — the seat's claim carries the reason.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at `d0a7e748` (seat, 2026-10-27T04:57Z): **holds** — the four patrol files, the four guard files and `lint.yml` all exist under `.github/workflows/`; `half-state-patrol.yml` and `governed-surface-guard.yml` also exist and are ⛔ NOT in scope (not named by the ruling). #26236, which triage named as the gate for (i), is closed — (i) is unblocked by it; before opening (i) read the file list of open PR #26482 (`ci: gate steps run their root check:* alias…`, not draft) — if it edits `lint.yml`, wait for it to land and base on it; say which in the PR body.
1. Permissions: each merged job keeps exactly the `permissions:` block its source workflow declared (job-level, never widened to workflow-level); secrets/env the same; `concurrency:` groups kept per job where the source had one.
2. Failure signal: each job's name on the Checks tab stays readable as the patrol/guard it was (name the job after the retired file); any `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` roster row that names a retired job name is re-pointed (that roster is a hand list — card #26439 wants it derived; do not do #26439's work here, re-point only).
3. (i): the skip step uses the Actions REST API through `GITHUB_TOKEN` with `actions: read` (or `gh run list` with the same), looks for a `push` run of `lint.yml` on `github.sha` with `conclusion: success`, and makes later steps/jobs `if:`-conditional on its output; the `push` and `pull_request` legs are untouched; `check:ci-filter-parity` and `check-required-contexts` stay green and unchanged.
4. Every retired workflow's last run must be visible to the merged job's reader: say in the PR body how the per-job history is found after the rename (the Actions UI lists by workflow file).

### Card-specific clauses

- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26071` on the LAST PR only (`Part-of #26071` on the first two, as `AGENTS.md`'s closing-keyword rule spells it — read it), then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (Tier H: 需要你做的 names the one action: approve), then What changes (the file-by-file diff narrative), Tests, Acceptance notes, Verification. ⛔ No model name anywhere in commits or PRs; the model-free trailer pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on each final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; `actionlint` if the repo wires it; long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26071`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after a PR opens — but do not open the next PR before the previous merged.
- ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee. ⛔ No GitHub MCP tools, reads included.
- Final report per PR: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26071 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back after each PR: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, head sha, report comment id and premise verdict; stay subscribed to each PR for the contract review's verdict and a possible patch round.
